title: Craft
description: This mod removes the ability to mine in Survival!
body:
# This mod removes the ability to **mine in Survival**.
Due to **Mojang Studio** updating their game, they have **accidentally broken their most important feature**. **MINING**!!! The game is now just **CRAFT**! Find new ways to play your game and beat the **Ender Dragon**!

<details>
<summary>What's New?</summary>

### Here are the new featires added in this new "update":

- You can no longer **mine in Survival**.
- You are granted a **Crafting Table** every time you load into a world.

</details>

<details>
<summary>What Didn't Change?</summary>

### These are features that weren't changed to make a fair gameplay experience and to make this possible:

- **Endermen can pick up and move blocks**.
- You can **still place blocks** (but be careful as you **still can't break them**).
- Any **explosion breaks blocks and drops them**.
- You can **still use TNT**.

</details>
